sources.title: OralGPT: Specialized Dental Multimodal AI - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: OralGPT is a family of dental-specific vision-language systems that integrate image analysis with language-based diagnostic reporting. These systems adapt large-scale multimodal models with dental data and structured supervision to generate measurement-aware, clinically relevant outputs.
